common.footer: {{org}} · PROSM Time - an automatic message from the attendance system.

leave.subject: Leave request - {{name}} - {{period}}
leave.answerDecider: To answer the person who decided:

request.title: A leave request awaits your review
request.intro: {{name}} asked for {{type}}, {{period}}. Review it in the app.

sent.title: Your leave request was sent
sent.intro: Your request ({{type}}, {{period}}) went to {{to}}. The answer will come on this same thread.

requestWithdrawn.title: A leave request was withdrawn
requestWithdrawn.intro: {{name}} withdrew the request for {{type}}, {{period}}, before it was answered. Nothing is needed from you.
requestWithdrawn.copyIntro: You withdrew your request for {{type}}, {{period}}; {{to}} has been told.

withdrawn.title: An approved leave was withdrawn
withdrawn.intro: {{name}} withdrew their approved {{type}}, {{period}}; its days are back in their balance. Nothing is needed from you.
withdrawn.copyIntro: You withdrew your {{type}}, {{period}}; its days are back in your balance.

approved.title: Your leave is approved 🎉
approved.intro: Congratulations, {{name}}! Your {{type}} is approved, {{period}}. Enjoy your time off.
approved.introBalance: Congratulations, {{name}}! Your {{type}} is approved, {{period}}; {{remaining}} of your balance remain. Enjoy your time off.

cancelled.title: Your leave is cancelled
cancelled.intro: Your approved {{type}}, {{period}}, was cancelled; its days are back in your balance.

rejected.title: Your leave request was not approved

invite.subject: You're invited to join {{org}} on PROSM Time
invite.title: You're invited to {{org}} on PROSM Time
invite.body: Hi {{name}}, you've been invited to join {{org}} on PROSM Time as {{role}}. Enter the code below in the app to accept your invitation and set up your account.
invite.ignore: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your PROSM Time password
reset.title: Reset your PROSM Time password
reset.body: Hi {{name}}, we received a request to reset your PROSM Time password. Enter the code below in the app to choose a new one.
reset.ignore: If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email - your password will not change.

trial.licenseSubject: Your PROSM Time licence ends on {{date}}
trial.licenseRenew: Renew it before then so the app keeps running; all your data is kept:
trial.endingSubject: Your PROSM Time trial ends on {{date}}
trial.endingBody: The PROSM Time trial of {{org}} ends on {{date}}. Your data is kept and will not be deleted.
trial.endingContinue: To continue, contact the sales team to renew the licence (licence {{license}}):
trial.endedSubject: Your PROSM Time trial has ended
trial.endedBody: The PROSM Time trial of {{org}} has ended. The organisation is now read-only: everyone can still see everything, and all your data is kept.
trial.endedContinue: Enter an activation code in Settings > Subscription after signing in, or contact us, and everything works as before (licence {{license}}):

licence.subject: PROSM Time - licence of {{org}} changed
licence.intro: PROSM changed the licence of {{org}} in PROSM Time (number {{license}}):
licence.applied: The change already applies in the app. The new licence is attached as a PDF, and you also find it in Settings > Subscription.

pdf.title: PROSM Time licence certificate
pdf.footer: Issued automatically by PROSM when the licence changed. Questions: support@prosm.net
